purpose: Real end-to-end exercise of Nova A98's R3 acceptance criterion (resumable Full Verify) -- prior evidence was code-plus-unit-tests only (nova-verify-journal-tests, nova-verify-resume-tests, both green in every Verify run), never a live cross-invocation exercise.
mechanism: harness/scripts/verify.mjs -> plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/verify-journal.mjs (runVerifyJournal) -> plugins/pipeline-core/lib/verify-resume.mjs (planVerifyResume/firstDrift). No code was modified to produce this evidence -- two real, unmodified `node harness/scripts/verify.mjs` invocations against the same clean, unchanged candidate, back to back.

runB.role: same-candidate resume, immediately after runA with no intervening commit

observation: Every one of runB's 269 progress-journal entries carries state:"reused" (verified by grep -c against the raw progress stream, count 269/269), each with a startedAt/completedAt delta of ~1ms, versus runA's real per-suite execution times. runB's total wall time (1.84s) is ~108x faster than runA's (198.75s) for an identical 269-suite candidate. This is the harness's own explicit self-report (the state field), not an inference from receipt content.

negativeControlAlreadyOnRecord.description: The same session separately ran Verify twice against two DIFFERENT candidates one commit apart (f377b3f4 then a3197af3) and observed ZERO reuse (269/269 fresh in the second run) -- firstDrift's candidate-drift check (verify-resume.mjs:66) correctly invalidates every receipt the instant commit/tree differs, before any per-suite content check runs. This is the expected, conservative counterpart to the positive result above: reuse triggers only for a genuinely unchanged candidate, never merely a 'similar' one.

verification.howChecked: grep -c '"state":"reused"' against runB's persisted raw progress-stream output (269 matches); git rev-parse HEAD confirmed unchanged (2f34c1ccbcd454ba1fd2095c9a45625632333387) across both runs; evidence/verify-latest.json's own verifyRun block cross-checked (registeredSuiteCount: 269, terminalReceiptCount: 269, status: passed) for runB.

commands: node harness/scripts/verify.mjs (runB, immediately after, no commit in between)

scopeNote: This closes Nova A98's R3 acceptance criterion (resumable Full Verify, genuinely exercised with real evidence) but does not close #98 as a whole -- R4 (Critic delta lineage for the release path) and R6 (integrated fixtures) remain the real, undesigned gaps, per docs/adr/0064's own Context section.
